11. REMOVE SPEEDOMETER DRIVE GEAR
    Pry out both ends of the clip and remove the drive gear.

12. MEASURE COUNTER FIFTH GEAR THRUST CLEARANCE
    Using a feeler gauge, measure the counter 5th gear thrust
    clearance.
    Standard clearance:  0.10 — 0.41 mm
                        (0.0039 — 0.0161 in.)
    Maximum clearance:  0.46 mm (0.0181 in.)

13. REMOVE COUNTER REAR BEARING, SPACER, COUNTER
    FIFTH GEAR AND NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
    (a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

    (b) Using SST, remove the rear bearing, spacer, 5th gear
        and bearing.
        SST 09213-36020
        NOTICE: Be careful not to catch the output shaft rear
        bearing roller on the counter 5th gear.
    (c) Remove the spacer.

14. REMOVE NO.3 HUB SLEEVE ASSEMBLY
    (a) Using two screwdrivers and a hammer, tap out the
        snap ring.
